result.document_summary: A mis-matched page of San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 5 text on synthetic drug prohibitions, aggressive solicitation and cruising, with no rental housing content.
result.notes: The URL suggests San Diego's algorithmic rent-setting prohibition (Division 11), but this part of the document contains only unrelated Municipal Code material (a list of Schedule I and synthetic drug compounds, Division 33 synthetic drug sale/possession prohibitions, Division 40 aggressive solicitation, and the start of Division 50 cruising definitions). No rule in any of the six rental-housing categories appears in this part, so no records are extracted.
